Show the manual page of a command

Usage: slipway man [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]...

Arguments:
  [COMMAND]...  The command whose page to show, such as rollout undo

Options:
      --path             Print the directory of the bundled pages and exit
      --install[=<DIR>]  Copy every page into a man1 directory
  -h, --help             Print help (see more with '--help')

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
